gates.name: Data freshness
gates.rule: Stat inputs must come from the current season's official stats hub and be re-pulled each slate; stale data fails the gate.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: A signal needs at least 10 games of sample before it is eligible; early-season noise fails the gate.

gates.name: Official source only
gates.rule: Every row must link to an official/trusted source (nba.com, official.nba.com, stats.nba.com, gleague.nba.com). Unverifiable values are left blank and flagged, never inferred.

gates.name: Injury/availability check
gates.rule: Check the official NBA Injury Report: participation status due 5 p.m. local the day before a game, 1 p.m. local on the second night of a back-to-back; reports update continually on game day.

gates.name: Correlation screen
gates.rule: Parlay legs must pass a correlation screen; same-player multi-leg combos are rejected as highly correlated. Correlation values not confirmable from official sources are flagged, not filled in.

gates.name: Parlay size cap
gates.rule: Parlays capped at 3 legs to limit compounding of correlated/luck-driven outcomes.

gates.name: Luck-removal review
gates.rule: Strategies are graded on repeatability: a strategy must show the signal persisting across independent samples before leaderboard credit; single-game variance does not count.
